soru: Veri değerleme ve veri paraya çevirme için ölçütler, KPI'lar ve taksonomiler üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Veri değerleme ve veri paraya çevirme için ölçütler, KPI'lar ve taksonomiler üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2025-07-25. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Data Valuation in Machine Learning: "Ingredients", Strategies, and Open Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: This IJCAI survey sets out a formal taxonomy of ML data valuation (ingredients, strategies) and the main open challenges.

calismalar.baslik: Data Shapley: Equitable Valuation of Data for Machine Learning
calismalar.gerekce: It made the Shapley value the standard way to measure each data point's contribution to a model.

calismalar.baslik: Towards Efficient Data Valuation Based on the Shapley Value
calismalar.gerekce: It gave the first efficient approximation algorithms for computing Shapley-based data values.

calismalar.baslik: A Survey on Data Pricing: from Economics to Data Science
calismalar.gerekce: A foundational survey that brings together data pricing principles and models from economics through data science.

calismalar.baslik: A Systematic Survey of Data Value: Models, Metrics, Applications and Research Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: A systematic review of data value models, assessment metrics and applications, with a set of open research questions.

calismalar.baslik: A Review of Data Valuation Approaches and Building and Scoring a Data Valuation Model
calismalar.gerekce: It groups market-, economics- and dimension-based data valuation approaches and proposes a scoring model for organisations.

calismalar.baslik: What is the value of data? A review of empirical methods
calismalar.gerekce: It reviews empirical data valuation methods in economics and offers a typology that matches methods to data types and purposes.

calismalar.baslik: A Marketplace for Data: An Algorithmic Solution
calismalar.gerekce: It gives an algorithmic data marketplace design with a fairness notion and a truthful auction for freely replicable data goods.

calismalar.baslik: A Survey of Data Marketplaces and Their Business Models
calismalar.gerekce: It classifies the business models and pricing practices of 190 commercial data trading entities.

calismalar.baslik: Data Pricing in Machine Learning Pipelines
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys data and model pricing at every stage of the ML pipeline (collection, collaborative training, deployment).

calismalar.baslik: Query-Based Data Pricing
calismalar.gerekce: It set the theoretical basis for arbitrage-free, query-based pricing in data markets.

calismalar.baslik: Towards Model-based Pricing for Machine Learning in a Data Marketplace
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced the framework of pricing ML model instances directly instead of the underlying data.

calismalar.baslik: How to Monetize Your Data
calismalar.gerekce: It set the widely used three-way data monetisation taxonomy: improving processes, wrapping products, and selling information.

calismalar.baslik: Data Monetization: Lessons from a Retailer's Journey
calismalar.gerekce: A foundational IS case study of the stages, benefits and risks of data monetisation.

calismalar.baslik: Capturing value from big data – a taxonomy of data-driven business models used by start-up firms
calismalar.gerekce: It gives an empirical taxonomy of data-driven business models and revenue streams.

calismalar.baslik: Measuring the Value of Information: An Asset Valuation Approach
calismalar.gerekce: It founded the accounting-based approach to valuing information as an asset, including the 'laws of information'.

calismalar.baslik: Discovering Business Models of Data Marketplaces
calismalar.gerekce: It builds a business model taxonomy and archetypes for data marketplaces.

calismalar.baslik: OpenDataVal: a Unified Benchmark for Data Valuation
calismalar.gerekce: The first standardised benchmark for data valuation algorithms; it shows no single method is best on every task.

calismalar.baslik: Beta Shapley: a Unified and Noise-reduced Data Valuation Framework for Machine Learning
calismalar.gerekce: It relaxes the efficiency axiom and unifies data valuation methods under the semivalue family.

calismalar.baslik: Data Banzhaf: A Robust Data Valuation Framework for Machine Learning
calismalar.gerekce: It gives a data value that is maximally robust to training randomness, with an efficient MSR estimator.

calismalar.baslik: Data Valuation using Reinforcement Learning
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced the learning-based (meta-learning) approach to data valuation.

calismalar.baslik: Data-OOB: Out-of-bag Estimate as a Simple and Efficient Data Value
calismalar.gerekce: It offers a cheap, scalable data value based on out-of-bag estimates from bagging.

calismalar.baslik: LAVA: Data Valuation without Pre-Specified Learning Algorithms
calismalar.gerekce: It brought in model-agnostic data valuation using an optimal transport (Wasserstein) distance.

calismalar.baslik: Efficient Task-Specific Data Valuation for Nearest Neighbor Algorithms
calismalar.gerekce: It gives exact, fast KNN-Shapley computation, which makes large-scale valuation practical.

calismalar.baslik: Modern Data Pricing Models: Taxonomy and Comprehensive Survey
calismalar.gerekce: It gives a taxonomy of modern data pricing models and links value and quality to pricing.

calismalar.baslik: Understanding Black-box Predictions via Influence Functions
calismalar.gerekce: It established the influence-function approach to estimating the effect of training data, a core tool for data valuation.

calismalar.baslik: Foundations for Data Monetization
calismalar.gerekce: An MIT CISR working paper that defines the classes of data monetisation offerings and the capabilities they require.

calismalar.baslik: A Distributional Framework for Data Valuation
calismalar.gerekce: It extends data values to the underlying data distribution, so they are stable and transferable across datasets.

calismalar.baslik: Data Shapley in One Training Run
calismalar.gerekce: It brings Shapley-based data valuation to foundation-model scale, tackling the open problem of computational cost.

calismalar.baslik: Training Data Influence Analysis and Estimation: A Survey
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys influence and training-data contribution estimation methods together with their open problems.
